verses.text: \s1 Paupuina
\x - \xo 1:1 \xt Hleh 18:19-21; 19:1.\x*Pathian deina bang in Jesus Christ i sawltak keima Paul in, Christ Jesus sungah a thuman le Ephisa a om mithiangtho te:
I Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ kung pan thuthiamna le thinnopna sia note tungah hong om tahen.

Ih Topa Jesus Christ i Pa le Pathian tungah lungdam ko tawng! Banghangziam cile Christ taw kipumkhatna sungah ama in eite sia vantung ngam taw kisai thupha theampo hong pia hi.   
\s1 Thaa Thupha
Leitung a ki bitphua ma in hong it ahikom Amai ah a thiangtho le paubangngawl i hi thei natu in Christ sungah hong teal zo hi:
Pathian in Ama deina le lungkimna bang in Jesus Christ tungtawn in ta i sua thei natu in hong tealkhol zo hi,
Ama thuthiamna manpha pok tu in a it a Tapa sungah san thei a hi tu in hong vawt zo hi.
\x - \xo 1:7 \xt Hleh 18:19-21; 19:1.\x*A dimlet thuthiamna bang in, Ama sungah Christ thisan tungtawn in tatna le maw maisakna i nei hi;
Ama in eite tungah pilna le heakna theampo hong khangsak zo hi;
Ama sungah a ngealkhol na le a pha a lungkimna bang in, Ama deina thuku sia eite tungah hong hesak hi.
Taciang hunkhenna hun te a cin ciang in vantung na theampo le leitung na theampo te sia a vekpi in Christ sungah ki kaikhawm siat tu hi:
Na theampo sia Ama deina le a ngaisutna bang in vawt a, Ama ngealna bang in hong teal hi, tabang in Ama sungah ngamh i lua zo hi:
Tabang in Christ sungah lametna amasabel a nei eite tungtawn in Pathian minthanna i pok tu hi.
Ama na muang uh a, note tatna lungdamna thupha thuman kammal na zak zawk uh, Ama na up uh ciang kamciam Tha Thiangtho taw hong ciamte zo hi,

Tua Tha Thiangtho sia Ama minthanna pok tu in a leisa nate a tat kik mateng, i lua tu ngamh atu in vaukhaamna a hihi.   
\s1 Lungdamko le Thungen
Tua ahikom keima zong Jesus Christ sungah na upna uh le mithiangtho te theampo na itna uh thu ka zak zawkciang in,
Note atu in Pathian tungah lungdam ka ko tawntung hi, ka thungetna ah hong hel tawntung khi hi;
Tabang in minthanna i Pa, i Topa Jesus Christ i Pathian in note tungah pilna thaa le Ama heakna sungah thu pualakna hong pia tahen.
Note in Ama sapna i lametna, mithiangtho te i a minthang ngamh le hauna na heak thei natu uh in, na thinsung mit hong vaksak hi,
Taciang Ama vangletna lian nasep ngeina bang in, a um eite tungah Ama vangletna bangza in lian ziam,
\x - \xo 1:20 \xt Psa 110:1.\x*Tua vangletna taw Christ sia thina pan thokiksak a, Ama ziatsang vantung ah a koi ciang in Christ sungah a vawt a hihi,
Ama sia thuneina, vangletna, hatna le ukzawkna theampo ahizong, taciang tu hun le hongpai lai tu hun sungah min theampo sang in ahizong, nasiatakin sang zaw hi:
\x - \xo 1:22 \xt Psa 8:6.\x*\x - \xo 1:22 \xt Kol 1:18.\x*Taciang Ama peangnuai ah na theampo koi siat a, pawlpi i na theampo tungah a lubel dinmun pia hi,
Tasia Ama pumpi hi a, na theampo ah na theampo taw a dimsak tu Ama pilna a hihi.
\x - \xo 2:1 \xt Hleh 18:19-21; 19:1.\x*Na tatkhialna uh te le na mawna uh te sungah na thi zo uh a, tua pan in hong nungtasak kik hi;
A bosa hun sungah leitung ngeina bang in ahizong, hui sung a om vangletna a ukpa ngeina bang in ahizong in, thu ni ngawl tate sungah na a seam thaa ngeina bang in ahizong, note na nungta ngei uh hi:
Eite zong ngualdang te bangma in a bosa hun sungah cilesa deina sungah i nungta a, i pumpi le i thinsung i deina teng i kicingsak hi; taciang cilesa ngeina bang in thin-ukna i tate i hihi.
Ahihang thuthiamna taw a dim Pathian in itna lianpi taw hong it hi,
Mawna sungah i thi laitak in, Christ taw hong nungta khawmsak hi, thuthiamna tungtawn in ngupna na nga uh hi;
Taciang hong tho khawmsak zo a, Christ Jesus sungah van ah hong to khawmsak hi:
Tua thu sia hongpai tu hun sungah eite tungah Ama thuthiamna i a lamdang hauna sia a phatna sungah Christ Jesus tungtawn in hong lak thei natu a hihi.
Banghangziam cile note sia thuthiamna hang in upna tungtawn in ngupna na nga zo uh hi; taciang tua ngupna sia note pan in hong piang hi ngawl hi: hi sia in Pathian letsong a hihi:
Sepna hang hi ngawl hi, tua ahikom kuama ki suantak tu hi ngawl hi.

Banghangziam cile eite sia Pathian i khutma te i hihi, Christ Jesus sungah nasep pha te a seam tu in a ki bitphua te i hihi, tua nasep pha te sungah i nuntak thei natu in Pathian in hong ciangtan hi.   
\s1 Christ Sungah Pumkhat
Tua ahikom a bosa hun sungah note sia cilesa deina taw Gentile mite na hi uh a, cilesa deina taw in khut taw vunteap tan te in vunteap tan ngawl te, hong ci uh hi, ci phawk tawntung tavun;

Tua hun in note in Christ na nei bua uh hi, Israel minam sungah ki hel ngawl in peamta te na hi uh hi, taciang kamciam thu te pan zong peamta te na hi uh hi, taciang leitung ah Pathian na nei bua uh a, lametna zong na nei bua uh hi:
Nidang in note sia a khuala mama na ah na om ngei uh a, Christ thisan tungtawn in hong naisak kik a, tu in Christ Jesus sungah na om uh hi.
Banghangziam cile Ama sia i thinnopna hi a, Ama in pumkhat in hong vawt hi, taciang i ki laklaw ah hong khak kidalna sia baltham zo hi;

\x - \xo 2:15 \xt Kol 2:14.\x*Ama in ki ngalvawtna, biakna ngeina sung a om thupiak te sia Ama pumpi sungah bosak siat zo hi; banghangziam cile Ama sungah mihing ni sia mihing thak khat vawt tu in kilemna vawt hi;
\x - \xo 2:16 \xt Kol 1:20.\x*Taciang thinglamte tungtawn in mihing ni sia Pathian tungah pumpi khat hi tu a, kilemna vawtsak tu in, ki ngalvawtna that hi:
\x - \xo 2:17 \xt Isa 57:19.\x*Taciang a khualapi a om note le a nai a omte tungah Christ hongpai a, kilemna thu hong hil hi.

Banghangziam cile Christ tungtawn in ahizong, Thaa khat tungtawn in ahizong, Pa kungah i tum thei hi.   
\s1 Pathian Innkuanpui
Tua ahikom, tu in note sia peamta te le ngamdang mite na hi nawn bua uh hi, ahihang mithiangtho te taw ngam khat i mi le Pathian innkuanpui na hi uh hi;
Taciang note sia sawltak te le kamsang te i phungkawng tungah a kisa te na hi uh a, Jesus Christ ama cikteak sia a lianbel phungkawng a hihi;
Ama sungah innpi theampo phatak in ki zom dimdiam a, Topa sungah biakinn thiangtho a hi tu in na khang khawm tek uh hi:
Ama sungah note sia Thaa tungtawn in Pathian om natu in munkhat ah a kisa khawm te na hi uh hi.
Hisia thu hu in keima Paul sia no Gentile te atu, Jesus Christ min taw thongtak pa ka hihi,
Note kungah Pathian thuthiamna a keamcing tu nasep sia keima tungah hong pia hi, ci thu na za zo uh ahile:
Nidang in tawmno ka at sa bangma in, hong kilaak na tungtawn in thuku sia ka tungah hong he sak hi,
\x - \xo 3:4 \xt Kol 1:26,27.\x*Tua ka at thu na sim uh ciang in Christ i thuku ka heakna sia note in na telthiam tu uh hi,
Tua thuku sia tu in Ama sawltak te le kamsang thiangtho te tungah Thaa tungtawn in a kilang bang in, hun tatuam sungah mihing te tungah he sak ngei ngawl hi;
Tabang in Gentile mite sia lungdamna thupha tungtawn in ngamhlua te le pumpi khat sungah pumkhat suak tu in Christ sungah Ama kamciam a sang khawm te a hi thei natu a hihi:
Ama i a vanglian nasepna tungtawn in ka tungah hongpiak Pathian thuthiamna letsong bang in, hi lungdamna thupha naseam tu in hong vawt hi.
A kikan zo ngawl Christ i hauna thu sia Gentile mite sungah ka hil thei natu in, mithiangtho theampo sungah a nobel sang in a no zaw keima tungah hi thuthiamna hong pia hi;
Jesus Christ tungtawn in na theampo a bitphua Pathian sungah, leitung piancil pan kipan a phualseal ki pawlkhopna thuku sia mi theampo tungah hong musak tu hi:
Tu in vantung ah thuneina te le vangletna te sia pawlpi in Pathian pilna tampi a heak thei natu ngealna a hihi,
Tua thu sia tawntung ngealna bangma in i Topa Christ Jesus sungah ngealna hi a:
Tua i Topa Christ Jesus sungah Ama i upna tungtawn in hangsan le kimuanna taw tum thei na i nei hi.

Tua ahikom note atu in ka haksatna sungah na thaneam ngawl tu uh ka dei hi, banghangziam cile hi haksatna sia note vangletna a hihi.   
\s1 Paul in Ephesus Pawlpi atu Thungen
Hi thu hang in i Topa Jesus Christ i Pa tungah ka khupdin a,
Vantung le leitung a om innkuan buppi sia minphuasa a hihi,
Tabang in Ama minthanna hauna bang in A Thaa thahatna taw note i sungsang mihing tha hong dim tu in ahizong;
Na thinsung uh ah Christ sia na upna uh tungtawn in om tu a; itna sungah zungtha le zungkip in na om thei natu uh ahizong,
Mi thiangtho te taw Christ itna a zaina, a sauna, a thukna le a sanna, na heak thei natu uh ahizong;
Tua Christ itna sia heakna sang in sangzaw a, Pathian kicinna taw na theampo na kidim thei natu uh ahizong, thu kong ngetsak hi.
Tu in kote sungah naseam pa vangletna bang in, i ngetna ahibale, i ngaisutna theampo i tungah a dimlet in na a seam thei pa tung ah,
Pawlpi sung le Christ Jesus tungtawn in hun theampo sungah tawp ni nei ngawl leitung dong in minthang tahen. Amen.
\s1 Christ Pumpi Sungah Pumkhat Hina
Tua ahikom, Topa atu thong a tak keima in, note hong ki sapna taw a kiphu in nungta tu in kong thum hi,
\x - \xo 4:2 \xt Co. 3:12, 13\x*Ki niamkhiakna le nunneamna, thinsauna, itna taw khat le khat na ki dual tavun;
Thinnopna taw ki khiina sungah ki pumkhatna Thaa sia hanciam in na keamcing tavun.
Lametna khat sungah note hong sap bang in, pumpi khat om a, Thaa khat om hi;
Topa khat, upna khat le tuiphumna khat om hi,

Pathian khat om a mi theampo i Pa a hihi, Ama sia na theampo i tungah om a, mi theampo sungah om hi, taciang note theampo i sung zong ah om hi.   
\s1 Thaa Letsong
Ahihang Christ i letsong a tena bang in eite khatsim sia thuthiamna hong pia tek hi.
\x - \xo 4:8 \xt Ps 68:8\x*Tua ahikom Ama sia a sangna ah a ki lakto lai in, ngal mat te tonpui a, mihing te tungah tel te pia hi, ci hi.
Tu in ama sia ki lato zo hi, i cile, lei nuai sangah tuaksuk masa hi ngawl ziam?
A nuaisang ah a tuaksuk pa sia vantung a sang mama na ah a kato pa ma hi a, Ama in na theampo kicingsak tu hi.
Taciang Ama in pawlkhat te sia sawltak nasep; taciang pawlkhat te sia kamsang nasep; taciang pawlkhat te sia thuphapuak nasep; taciang pawlkhat te sia pastor te le sya nasep pia hi;
Hi tel te a piakna sia mithiangtho te picingsak tu in ahizong, Pathian nasep seam tu ahizong, taciang Christ pumpi khantosak natu ahizong:
Eite theampo in upna ki pumkhatna ah i thet tek thei natu in ahizong, Pathian Tapa i heakna sungah mi picing i hi thei natu in ahizong, Christ i kicinna tena ah i picin thei natu ahizong:
Tu pan kipan in hilna huiva in a ukna mun theampo ah a letkhiat le mihing te thimthelna le leilot thu taw a kitheam patang te i hi nawn batu hi;
Ahihang thutak sia itna taw son tu a, na theampo sungah i lutang Christ sungah i khang tek tu hi:

\x - \xo 4:16 \xt Col 2:19\x*Ama Christ i tung pan in pumpi theampo phatak in kizom siat a, ngu le tang khatsim taw kizom siat hi, pumpi khen khatsim i nasep theina, hatna, tena bang in, pumpi sia khang tu a, itna sungah ama le ama ki khangtosak tu hi.   
\s1 Christ Sungah Nuntakna Thak

Tua ahikom hi thu kong son hi, taciang Topa sungah tetti ka pang hi, tabang in tu pan kipan in Gentile dang te in amate thinsung ah a mannung ngawl te ngaisun a, a nuntak uh bang in note na nungta heak vun,
Amate i heakna sia mial a, amate sungah mawmawtna tungtawn in Pathian nuntakna taw kikhen uh hi, banghangziam cile amate thinsung mit uh taw a hihang a hihi:
Amate sia maizum zong he nawn ngawl uh a, a thiangtho ngawl te sia duhopna taw vawt tu in amate le amate ki ap uh hi.
Ahihang note in Christ thu sia tabang hi ngawl tu in na sin bua uh hi;
Christ thu na za zo uh a, Ama in hong hil zo ahile, thuman sia Jesus sungah a ombang in:
\x - \xo 4:22 \xt Col 3:9\x*Cilesa thangaina i theamna bang in a kisia sa nidang lai mihing lui nuntakzia te na sut tavun;
Taciang na thinsung uh le na thaa uh sia ki puapha tahen;
\x - \xo 4:24 \xt Col 3:10\x*Thutang suana le thianthona man tatak sungah Pathian a kisun in bitphua na, mi thak hina sia sil tavun.
\x - \xo 4:25 \xt Zec 8:16\x*Tua ahikom leilot thu te vawk vun a, mihing khatsim in a innpam ah thuman son tahen: banghangziam cile eite sia pumpi khat i pumpi khen te i hihi.
\x - \xo 4:26 \xt Ps 4:4\x*Note thin-uk vun a, maw heak vun: na thin-ukna uh ni tumpui heak vun:
Nguta thei te in ngu nawn heak tahen; naseam zaw tahen, nasep pha sia ama khut te taw seam tahen, tabang in ama in a kisam te pia thei tu hi.
Na kam pan in kammal sia te pusuak heak hen, ahihang a zate tungah thuthiamna na seam tu le khantosak natu in zak tu kammal pha te pusuak zaw tahen.
Taciang tatkhiatna ni dong note ceptena hong khen Pathian Tha Thiangtho sia thinna sak heak vun.
A val lei phat ngawlna, thin-ukna, thinsona, aw ngampui in ausatna, kam phangawl pau le deisakna phangawl te note kung pan in vawk siat vun:
\x - \xo 4:32 \xt Col 3:13\x*Taciang note khat le khat tungah thinneamna taw phatna vawt vun a, Christ hang in Pathian in na mawna uh hong maisak bang in khat le khat ki maisak tavun.
\s1 Khuavak Sung Nuntakna
Tua ahikom note itna' tate bang in Pathian zui te na hi uh hi;
\x - \xo 5:2 \xt Exo 29:18; Psa 40:6. \x*Christ in hong it a, Pathian tungah ngimnamtui biakpiakna atu in ama le ama a ki piak bang in, itna sungah nungta vun.
Ahihang mithiangtho te na hi zawk uh bangma in paktatna, thiantho ngawlna theampo, a hibale, duhop nate sia note sungah khatvei zong son kul ngawl in om nawn heak tahen;
A lipkhap huai, mawmawt kampauna le ciammuina kammal phangawl te pau heak vun: tua te sang in lungdamna thu son zaw vun.
Banghangziam cile pasal pumpi zuak te, a thiangtho ngawl te, milim bia te a kici a duhop te sia Christ le Pathian kumpingam sungah ngamhlua ngawl tu hi, ci na he uh hi.
Kuama in a mannung ngawl kammal te taw hong theam heak tahen: banghangziam cile hi thu te hang in thuni ngawl tate tungah Pathian thin-ukna theng hi.
Tua ahikom note sia amate taw a ki pawl te na hi heak vun.
Banghangziam cile note sia khatveilai in khuazing na hi ngei uh hi, ahihang tu in note sia Topa sungah khuavak na hi uh hi: tua ahikom khuavak tate bang in nungta vun:
Banghangziam cile Thaa i nga sia na theampo sungah phatna, thutang suana le thuman a hihi;
Topa tungah a san thamman sia bangziam, ci tetti na lak vun.
Taciang bangma phattuamna om ngawl khuazing naseam te taw ki pawlkhopna nei heak vun, ahihang amate tek zaw tavun.
Banghangziam cile amate in kuama heak ngawl in a vawt uh nate a son tu uh zong a mai uh zum hi.
Ahihang tekna theampo te sia khuavak in kilangsak hi: banghangziam cile na theampo a kilangsak sia khuavak a hihi.
Tua ahikom, nang a mutthip pa awng, khanglo in a, thina pan tho in, taciang Christ in khuavak hong pia tu hi, ci hi.
Tua ahikom mi mawmaw te bang hi ngawl in, mipil te bang in kidawm in nungta vun,
\x - \xo 5:16 \xt Kol 4:5. \x*Tu hun sia hunphangawl ahikom, hun la in zangthiam vun.

Tua ahikom mawmaw heak vun, ahihang Topa deina a telthiam te hi zaw tavun.   
\s1 Thaa Taw Kidim Vun
A valkan thei ahi, sapittui na kham heak vun; tuasang in Thaa taw na kidim zaw vun;
\x - \xo 5:19 \xt Kol 3:16,17. \x*Noma le noma Psalm la, pokna la le tha la te taw ki paupui vun, na thinsung uh pan Topa tungah lasa in oai vun;
I Topa Jesus Christ min taw Pa Pathian tungah a tawntung in na theampo atu in lungdamko vun;
Pathian zatakna sungah khat le khat thu ki ni tavun.
\x - \xo 5:22 \xt Kol 3:18; 1Pe 3:1.\x*Zi te awng, Topa tung na kiap uh bangma in na pasal uh te tungah noma le noma ki ap vun.
Banghangziam cile pasal sia zi i lutang a hihi, tasia bangma in Christ sia pawlpi i lutang a hihi: taciang Ama sia a pumpi tanpa a hihi.
Tua ahikom pawlpi in Christ thu a nit bang in, zi te in na theampo sungah a pasal te thu ni tahen.
\x - \xo 5:25 \xt Kol 3:19; 1Pe 3:7.\x*Pasal te awng, Christ in pawlpi a it bangma in, na zi te uh it vun, taciang Christ in pawlpi atu in a nuntakna pia hi;
Tabang in Ama in tui taw a sil bang in Pathian thu taw thiangtak in thiangthosak tu ahizong,
Tabang in a minthang pawlpi sia a nin bang ngawl, a hibale a vunton ngawl, a hibale tabang na dang tatuam om ngawl, ahihang a thiangtho le paubang ngawl in Ama tungah a ap thei natu a hihi.
Tua ahikom pasal te in a zi te sia amate pumpi a it bang in a it tu a hihi. A zi a it peuma in ama le ama ki it a hihi.
Banghangziam cile pasal in, ama pumpi ngaimaw ngei ngawl hi; ahihang Topa in pawlpi vak in a khoi bangma in, a zi vak in khoi hi:
Banghangziam cile eite sia Ama pumpi sungah pumpikhen te, a pumpi le a ngu te i hihi.
\x - \xo 5:31 \xt Gen 2:24\x*Hi thu hang in pasal in a pa le a nu nusia tu a, a zi beal tu hi, taciang amate ni sia pumkhat hi tu hi.
Hi thu sia thuku lianpi a hihi: ahihang Christ le pawlpi thu taw kisai in kong son a hihi.
Ahihang note sungah a tuan in khatsim in a zi sia ama le ama a ki it bang in ahizong; taciang a zi in zong a pasal zakta tahen.
\x - \xo 6:1 \xt Col. 3:20\x*Tate awng, Topa sungah na nu le na pa te uh thu ni vun: banghangziam cile hisia sia a man a hihi.
\x - \xo 6:2 \xt Ex 20:12; Thuhlkk 5:16\x*Na nu le na pa zakta in; hi thu sia kamciam taw a masabel thupiak a hihi;
Tabang in nang atu in pha tu hi, taciang leitung ah na khansau tu hi.

\x - \xo 6:4 \xt Col 3:21\x*Taciang, no pa te awng, na tate uh thinsosak heak vun; ahihang Topa kepna le hil nate bang in khangtosak tavun.   
\s1 Sila le To
\x - \xo 6:5 \xt Col 4:1\x*Sila te awng, cilesa ngeina sungah na to te thu sia lau le ling kawm in ahizong, thinsung takpi taw ahizong, Christ thu na nit uh bang in ni vun;
Amate muna ah mihing lungkimsak te bangbek hi ngawl in; Christ i sila te bang in, Pathian deina sia na thinsung uh pan seam tavun;
Na nasep uh ciang in mihing te atu seam bang hi ngawl in, Topa atu seam bang in, deisakna pha taw seam tavun:
Sila ahizong, a suakta ahizong, akuamapo na pha a vawt theampo atu in Topa tung pan sangkik tu hi, ci sia he tavun.

\x - \xo 6:9 \xt Col 4:1; Thuhlkk10:17; Col 3:25\x*Taciang, no to te awng, tabangma in na sila te tungah vawt vun, lauthawn heak vun a: note zong van ah Topa na nei uh hi; Ama in kuama doidan nei ngawl hi.   
\s1 Pathian Ngalvan Kicing
Akhakbel in, ka suapui te awng, Topa le a hitheina vangletna sungah hattak in om vun.
Doaimangpa ngitlo theamna te langpan in na din zawk natu uh, Pathian ngalhiam theampo sil vun.
Banghangziam cile cilesa le thisan langpan in i do bua hi, ahihang thuneina te, vangletna te, hileitung khuazing a uk te, tungsang i a man ngawl thaa te i do hi.
Tua ahiciang hunphangawl te sungah na nalh zawk natu uh in le na theampo na vawt zawk uh ciang na din zawk thei natu uh in, Pathian ngalhiam theampo la vun.
\x - \xo 6:14 \xt a \xt Isa 11:5; \xt Isa 59:17\x*Tua ahikom thuman kawngkhau kil vun a, thutang suana awmdal bel vun;
\x - \xo 6:15 \xt Isa 52:7\x*Taciang kilemna lungdamna thupha hil tu kingin na peangdap bul vun;
Na theampo i tung ah, upna lum toai vun, taciang a phangawl pa i thal mei-kuang theampo dal in na mit thei tu uh hi.
\x - \xo 6:17 \xt Isa 59:17\x* Ngupna lukhu khu vun, taciang Pathian thu Thaa namsau toai vun:
Thaa sungah note i kisapna le thungetna theampo taw tatsat ngawl in thungen vun, taciang mithiangtho theampo atu in hanciam in thungetna taw ngak vun;
Taciang keima zong lungdamna thuku hesak tu in hangsantak in ka kam ka kat thei natu ahizong, ka hil tu thu hongpiak thei natu ahizong,

Tua lungdamna thupha atu in keima sia tongciin ka hi thei natu in, hencipna zong ka thuak hi: tua sungah ka son tu a kilawm thu hangsantak in ka son thei natu in thu hong ngetsak tavun.   
\s1 Akhakbel Paupuina
\x - \xo 6:21 \xt Sawl 20:4; 2 Tim 4:12\x*\x - \xo 6:21 \xt Col 4:7, 8.\x*Ahizong Topa sungah a muanhuai naseam le ka it suapui pa Tychicus in, keima thu le la theampo hong hesak tu hi:
Ama sia ka thu le la te hong hesak tu le, na thinsung uh he nepna na nga thei natu, tupna taw note kungah kong paisak a hihi.
Suapui te tung ah, Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ tung pan thinnopna le itna sia upna taw hong om tahen.
Citakna taw i Topa Jesus Christ a it te theampo tungah thuthiamna hong om tahen. Amen.
